settings.swatch_css: conic-gradient(red, yellow, lime, cyan, blue, magenta, red)

settings.label: Sheet Pricing
settings.body: Each gang sheet is priced by size, not by design count - fit as many designs as you can on a sheet at no extra cost. Need more than 40 feet? Increase the quantity and we will print multiple rolls.

settings.label: Features
settings.body: 9-color VIVID AF printing, 16.7 million colors, near-perfect Pantone matching, bright opaque whites, 100+ wash durability, and fine detail down to 3 pixels. Works on cotton, polyester, blends, canvas, denim and nylon.

settings.label: Specialty DTF Film Styles
settings.body: Beyond standard VIVID AF we print glitter, glow-in-the-dark, gold foil and silver foil gang sheets. Each specialty style ships press-ready with its own pressing card.

settings.label: Satisfaction Guarantee
settings.body: If a transfer does not press correctly or arrives with a print defect, we reprint it free. No return shipping, no restocking fee, no argument.

settings.label: Pressing Instructions
settings.body: Press at 300-320°F for 10-15 seconds with medium pressure, then peel. Peel temperature depends on the transfer type and is printed on the card that ships with every order.

settings.label: Shipping & Returns
settings.body: Most orders are printed and shipped within 24 hours. Free shipping on qualifying US orders. Because every gang sheet is made to order we cannot accept returns, but our reprint guarantee covers any defect.

settings.label: Art Upload Recommendations
settings.body: Upload PNG with a transparent background at 300 DPI for best results. We also accept PDF, AI, SVG, TIFF and JPG. Our art team reviews every file free and will flag anything that will not print cleanly.

settings.label: Downloadable Templates
settings.body: Not sure how to lay out a sheet? Download a ready-made gang sheet template sized to your chosen length, drop in your designs and upload the finished file here.
